fixed: Typing a Meter such as 3/2 or 4/4 on an English dance whose phrases are not named now sets the phrase structure's beats to the bar too, as it already did for named phrases, so a 32-bar dance in 3/2 fits its four 8-bar phrases and its figures get the right A and B labels instead of a warning that they don't fit. A structure whose parts have different beats to the bar is still never rewritten.

Re-importing a dance as English (for example a Caller's Companion dance first brought in as contra) now also takes the file's phrase structure when the dance had the standard one, so a dance in 3/2 or with uneven phrases gets its A and B labels in the right places. A phrase structure you set stays.
Turning a square's Free form switch back to what its kind gives is now saved: before, a dance that had Free form turned on (or off for patter) kept that choice on Save.
withReimportedChoreography takes the incoming phraseStructure with the incoming figures when the existing dance has the standard structure (''), as it already fills an empty meter and key.
